WelcomeText:
Rufin is native music player for Jellyfin, Navidrome/OpenSubsonic, Plex, and Emby servers;  local folders,  WebDAV including a direct Nextcloud browser login path, Samba and NAS shares.

This setup will install Rufin in your computer.

Click Next to continue.

Rufin has been installed on your computer.

Click Finish to finalize Setup.
